user.title: Add a Knit device
user.description: Knit your sensors into a smart device. Its settings can also be changed on its Knit card.

menu_options.light: Light: on and off from your sensors (motion, door, vibration) and the light level
menu_options.auto_off_switch: Motion-controlled device: off once its sensors clear (they never turn it on)
menu_options.appliance: Appliance: running / full / empty from its power (a dishwasher, a washing machine)
menu_options.charger: Charger: a device on battery, kept between two levels from its smart plug

light.title: Light
light.description: Pick the light (or the switch of a plug-controlled light) and what turns it on. Any on / off sensor works: motion, a door contact, vibration.

data_description.presence: It's on while any of them is on (motion, an open door, vibration), and counts down once they've all cleared.
data_description.illuminance: It only comes on when it's dark, and goes off once it's light. With several, their average is used.

advanced.name: Advanced options
advanced.description: Inverted sensors, pausing, a daily dark check, and brightness run by something else.

data.presence_off: Sensors that turn it on while off (inverted)
data.pause: Pause while these are on (e.g. guests)
data.dark_check: Turn on when this ends, if it's still dark
data.brightness_managed: Brightness is managed by something else (for example Adaptive Lighting, or other automations)
data.start_on: Turn its automatic features on now

data_description.presence_off: The other way round: on while a door is closed, or while there's no motion or vibration.
data_description.pause: Knit leaves it alone while they're on, and its card says Automations paused. With two or more, Configure then asks whether any or all of them pause it.
data_description.pause_match: Any one of them on, or only once all of them are.
data_description.dark_check: For a light with only light level sensors. A dull day may never count as light, so it never gets dark either: when this turns off (for example a morning time-of-day helper ending), the light comes on if it still counts as dark, unless Knit already turned it on for the dark since this turned on.
data_description.brightness_managed: Knit turns the light on without setting a brightness. It still dims it as a warning before it goes off, then hands the brightness back.
data_description.start_on: Turn this off if an automation already controls it, so the two don't both act on it.

auto_off_switch.title: Motion-controlled device
auto_off_switch.description: A device that should go off once nobody's around. It's never turned on for you.

data_description.presence: Motion, a door contact, vibration: it goes off once they've all been clear for its timeout.

advanced.name: Advanced options
advanced.description: Inverted sensors, pausing, and power cuts.

data.presence_off: Sensors that keep it on while off (inverted)
data.pause: Pause while these are on (e.g. guests)
data.off_after_outage: Off again if it comes back on after a power cut

data_description.presence_off: The other way round: it stays on while a door is closed, or while there's no motion or vibration.
data_description.pause: Knit leaves it alone while they're on, and its card says Automations paused. With two or more, Configure then asks whether any or all of them pause it.
data_description.pause_match: Any one of them on, or only once all of them are.
data_description.off_after_outage: For a device that shouldn't come back on by itself.
data_description.start_on: Turn this off if an automation already controls it, so the two don't both act on it.

appliance.title: Appliance
appliance.description: A dishwasher, washing machine or dryer on a smart plug that reports power.

data_description.power: Its smart plug's power: running while it draws power, finished once it stops.
data_description.door: On = open. Open for a while once it's not drawing power: emptied.

data_description.empty_name: Its status once emptied (and before the first cycle).
data_description.running_name: Its status while a cycle runs.
data_description.full_name: Its status once a cycle has finished, until it's emptied.

charger.title: Charger
charger.description: A device on battery (a music player, a tablet) charged from a smart plug: Knit keeps its battery between two levels.

data_description.battery: The device's battery: the plug goes on once it drops under Start below, and off at Stop at.
data_description.plug: The smart plug (or its switch) the device charges from.
data_description.charging: Optional, a sensor that says charging / full (or on while charging). The plug only goes off at Stop at once the device is seen charging, so an old reading from a device that's off the network never turns it off.

advanced.name: Advanced options
advanced.description: A full charge on a schedule, and only starting while someone's home.

data.full_charge: Charge to 100% while this is on
data.home: Only start while this is home

data_description.full_charge: A schedule (or any on / off entity): inside its times it charges to 100%, if it's under 95%.
data_description.home: A person (or any home / on entity): a low battery only turns the plug on while they're home. A charge already going carries on to Stop at.
data_description.start_on: Turn this off if an automation already runs the plug, so the two don't both act on it.

abort.already_configured: This is already a Knit device.

error.in_both_lists: A sensor can only be in one of the two sensor lists.
error.same_names: Give each status a different name.
